This is my take. Also don’t read if you don’t want spoilers.
We all know money is associated to everything that is important in this game. BuckMe is the new wave of holding and spending money, and also to how the story is played out.

In my opinion, considering things like:
-trading stocks in gta5 was possible
-gta memecoins such as DCTY seeming like a big part of the game (with big names in the crypto world saying “I just dont think this narrative is over” after it spiked to 20 million and nuked all the way down)
-us now having a new utility, buckme, which is essential to how the money and story moves in the game,

I think that it’s literally impossible that rockstar would not implement a stock or crypto aspect in this game. I remember doing stocks in gta5 when I was on the PS3 and that felt like it was 10 years ago. Gta5 lasted for so long and this game is designed to last for 2 decades. Rockstar is not going to miss out on something that is so big in the real world, in gta 6.
If not in story mode, then online. 
I feel like they didn’t add when the game came out because people would go crazy and do things like not put that 5000 into their family savings account 😭
If it happens, you guys already know that buckme checking account is going to have pocket change left because im putting all of it on trading 😂
 if any of that don’t happen, buckme doesn’t rely on trading to be something big because its so sewn into the game, it’s crazy. The name is a meme in itself.
Happy Thanks giving.
